description: Albany, NY – State Senator Liz Krueger (SD-28) and Assemblymember Steve Otis (AD-91) announced their legislation to create a rebate program for the purchase of electric landscaping equipment to assist commercial landscapers, local governments, school districts and other institutions (S.1574/A.2657) has been signed into law.
